newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 up, boosted by stronger Dow close.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 up, boosted by stronger Dow close.

text.p: UK stocks rose in early trade on Tuesday, tracking a rise on Wall Street though traders cautioned that the Dow rise was narrowly based and said markets remained cautious before a setpiece speech by Fed chief Alan Greenspan.

The FTSE 100 index was up 17.2 points at 4,348.7 by 0845 GMT with gaining stocks in a five-to-one majority. B.A.T propelled the advance, up 9p at 542 after a rise in Philip Morris shares in the United States.
"We are seeing a mark-up on the back of Wall Street but the Dow rise was made up of a relatively small number of big stocks," said one senior trader.
